name: What should landlords prepare before scheduling rental turnover repairs?

mainEntity.name: What should landlords prepare before scheduling rental turnover repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before booking a maintenance contractor, complete a detailed move-out walk-through and document every damaged area with photos and notes. Test all interior doors, inspect bathroom caulking and tile grout for cracks, check drywall corners, and note any damaged trim or baseboards. Gathering a clear, written punch list of cosmetic and functional issues before requesting an estimate helps your contractor arrive with the proper materials, assess trade requirements, and provide an accurate timeline to minimize vacancy.
acceptedAnswer.description: Complete a walk-through inspection, document damage with photos, and build a written punch list covering drywall, paint, trim, and plumbing fixtures before requesting quotes.
